en.title: Maximum Barrier That Keeps Total Energy at the Threshold
en.description:
The final energy of each particle is max(energy−barrier,0). Find the largest non-negative integer barrier such that the total energy is ≥th. The original total energy is guaranteed to be ≥th.

The input/output protocol was compiled independently by this site; upstream solutions are not executed.
en.input: The first line contains n th, and the second line contains n energies. 2≤n≤100000, 1≤energy≤10⁹, 1≤th≤10¹⁴.
en.output: Output the single integer required by the problem.
en.explanation: The answers to the three public examples are, in order: 3; 7; 5. All examples have been verified by independent small-scale enumeration or state search.
hints: Binary search for the last barrier at which the total energy is still not below the threshold.
